label: AWS Partner Network
terms_note: Only registered APN partners with Partner Central + an AWS account may call it; AWS SDK auth; APN terms apply; no fee for the API.

discovery.auth: aws_sigv4 (IAM credentials of the partner's AWS account linked to Partner Central)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (Partner Central Selling API — co-sell opportunities and engagement invitations for APN partners). Lane `human` → **keep** (partner gate). Confidence high.
auth: 1. Join APN, link Partner Central to an AWS account, create IAM credentials with Partner Central permissions.

endpoints.purpose: search + details (AWS-originated opportunities shared with the partner)

reference.limits: - APN membership required; AWS Customer Agreement + APN terms; SDK throttling limits apply. - Only registered APN partners with Partner Central + an AWS account may call it; AWS SDK auth; APN terms apply; no fee for the API.

fields.name: access_key_id
fields.help: Access key id of an IAM user or role session in the AWS Marketplace seller account linked to Partner Central, with a policy such as AWSPartnerCentralOpportunityManagement (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/partner-central/latest/developer-guide/setup-authentication.html).

fields.name: secret_access_key
fields.help: Secret access key of that IAM identity; never sent, used for the SigV4 signature.

fields.name: session_token
fields.help: Session token when the keys are temporary (assumed role / SSO); sent as X-Amz-Security-Token.

adapter.terms: AWS Partner Central Selling API (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/partner-central/latest/developer-guide/setup-authentication.html): awsJson1_0 — every request is a POST to https://partnercentral-selling.us-east-1.api.aws/ with Content-Type application/x-amz-json-1.0, X-Amz-Target AWSPartnerCentralSelling.<Operation> and an AWS SigV4 signature (service partnercentral-selling, us-east-1 only: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/partner-central/latest/developer-guide/selling-regions.html). The AWS account must be linked to Partner Central. Catalog is always AWS (production); Sandbox is not selectable.

me.note: No identity call exists in the Selling API; the probe lists one received engagement invitation, which verifies the signature and the Partner Central account link.

search_postings.note: ListEngagementInvitations (ParticipantType RECEIVER): opportunities and leads that AWS shared with the partner ('helping them track opportunities shared by AWS'), each {Id (engi-…), EngagementTitle, SenderCompanyName, InvitationDate, ExpirationDate (invitations expire after 15 days), Status (PENDING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, EXPIRED), PayloadType (OpportunityInvitation | LeadInvitation)}; paged with NextToken → next_cursor. query, category and min_budget are not sent (the API filters only by status, payload type, sender and engagement id).

get_posting.note: GetEngagementInvitation: the invitation with EngagementTitle, EngagementDescription, InvitationMessage, Payload.OpportunityInvitation {Customer, Project (Title, CustomerUseCase, ExpectedCustomerSpend …), SenderContacts, ReceiverResponsibilities} and EnrichmentContext insights (all in raw). Customer street address, contacts and AWS account id are only revealed after acceptance.

submit_bid.note: Accepting an AWS referral is the partner's commitment to pursue it: StartEngagementByAcceptingInvitationTask 'starts the engagement by accepting an EngagementInvitation' — asynchronously accepts it and creates an opportunity in the partner's account. bid_id is the TaskId (task-…), status the TaskStatus (IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, FAILED); poll with bid_status. AWS referrals carry no price, so amount, currency, period_days and message are not sent. Accepting cannot be undone.

bid_status.note: ListEngagementByAcceptingInvitationTasks filtered by TaskIdentifier: TaskStatus (IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, FAILED), ReasonCode/Message on failure, and OpportunityId of the opportunity created in the partner's account (raw).

not_offered.withdraw_bid: An accepted invitation cannot be withdrawn: RejectEngagementInvitation applies only to invitations not yet accepted ('If the partner decides not to pursue the opportunity, they can reject the invitation … Once rejected, access to the opportunity is lost', https://docs.aws.amazon.com/partner-central/latest/developer-guide/working-with-opportunities-from-aws.html), and it takes the invitation id, not the acceptance task id that submit_bid returns.
not_offered.list_messages: The Selling API has no messaging operations; its actions cover opportunities, engagement invitations, engagements, resource snapshots and solutions (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/partner-central/latest/APIReference/API_Operations.html).
not_offered.send_message: The Selling API has no messaging operations (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/partner-central/latest/APIReference/API_Operations.html); an invitation carries a one-way InvitationMessage from AWS.
not_offered.credits: Referrals are free to accept; the Selling API has no credit, quota-balance or connects concept (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/partner-central/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html).

live_check.notes: requires access_key_id, secret_access_key; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
